content.what_it_is: The file contains two FUNWAVE-TVD stage-update procedures. ESTIMATE_HUV (line 64) computes cell-centered discharge-derived velocities, finite-volume residuals for Eta/Ubar/Vbar with optional wavemaker mass injection, applies the Runge-Kutta ALPHA/BETA stage update and eta limits, then calls state reconstruction (lines 93-251). GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV (line 268) reconstructs H and, when dispersion is enabled, solves x and y tridiagonal systems for U and V; otherwise it divides depth-integrated momentum by depth, then masks dry cells and applies a Froude cap (lines 276-437).

unresolved: The x-system guard at line 318 uses tmp2.NE.0.0_SP OR MASK(I,J).GT.0, followed by divisions by tmp2 at lines 319-321. For any wet cell with MASK>0, tmp2==0 still enters the division branch, so the singularity check is ineffective.
The same OR-condition/division pattern is duplicated for the y system at lines 368-371, independently allowing division by zero in a wet cell.
ISTEP is accepted without a local range check at line 68 and indexes ALPHA and BETA at lines 210, 232, and 247; array safety depends on the caller enforcing the stage range.

The continuity residual divides by global DXg and DYg at lines 132-198, and momentum residuals divide by DX and DY at lines 228-245, without local nonzero-spacing checks; safety depends on initialization invariants outside this file.
WK_Source, kf, kd, and IM are declared at lines 70, 77, and 273 but have no active-code use in this file; their apparent uses are commented out or absent.
